files.legend.sop:
@legend.data.charts core.legend
    namespace=data.charts
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    imports=kids.arith
    imports=kids.shop
    imports=kids.tasks
    imports=kids.animals
    doc="Charts drawn by Chart.js: the chart types, their data and the options people can change by talking. The state holds the charts; the legend describes what one chart is."

@data.charts.chart core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="One chart: a type, a title, labelled numbers in one or more series, display options and the ids of the wires the numbers came from."
    example="Make a bar chart of what everyone has."
    negative="Tom has 5 apples."

@data.charts.chart.type core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which kind of chart is it (bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polar area or scatter)?"

@data.charts.chart.title core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What is the chart called?"

@data.charts.chart.label core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="Which labels (bars, slices or points) does the chart have?"

@data.charts.chart.series core.key
    value=string
    card=many
    ask="Which series (sets of numbers) does the chart have?"

@data.charts.chart.value core.key
    value=number
    card=many
    ask="Which numbers does the chart show?"

@data.charts.chart.color core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which color or palette does the chart use?"

@data.charts.chart.sort core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="How are the items ordered (biggest first, smallest first, alphabetically or as given)?"

@data.charts.chart.horizontal core.key
    value=boolean
    card=one
    ask="Does the chart lie on its side?"

@data.charts.chart.stacked core.key
    value=boolean
    card=one
    ask="Are the series stacked?"

@data.charts.chart.legend core.key
    value=boolean
    card=one
    ask="Is the legend shown?"

@data.charts.chart.showValues core.key
    value=boolean
    card=one
    ask="Are the numbers written on the chart?"

@data.charts.chart.source core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which wires did the numbers come from?"

    doc="Talk with charts drawn by the Chart.js library in the Charts tab: bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polar area and scatter. Charts are built from the conversation (what people have, the prices of the toys, a shopping list, the legs of the sea animals) or from numbers you type, and every number of such a chart keeps the ids of the wires it came from. Change the type, title, colors, order, orientation, labels, legend and stacking by language, ask about the data (biggest, total, average, difference, percentage), keep several charts, and download a chart as a picture. State lives in ctx.state; the tab renders it. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
